chapter_keywords: I was once a mote of common dust
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 569: Ji Ning's Despair and the Awakening of His Heart
chapter_meta_description: After Yu Wei's betrayal and the loss of the Divine Farmer's Medicine, Ji Ning sits alone in grief. In his deepest despair, his heart expands to cover the entire Grand Xia world, whispering a line that will change everything.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch.569 – A Mote of Common Dust
og_description: Ji Ning hits rock bottom as the war is lost. But from the ashes of his heart, a new power awakens.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 569: The Dust Mote's Ascent
twitter_description: No battle, no action—just Ji Ning alone on a city wall, broken by guilt. Then his heart begins to expand…

lore_anchors.definition: A world-altering alchemical item that immobilizes all Immortal ki within a vast area, turning cultivators into mortals; its defense is a meticulously prepared antidote.
A supreme war construct possessing Daofather-level strength and extreme toughness, virtually indestructible except by a Daofather's personal effort.
A colossal battle avatar formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations, representing the concentrated might of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals.
A realm of endless suffering within the Three Realms where souls are tortured for eternity; Yu Wei was cast here by the Godking.
A red-haired, powerful Heavenly God of the Grand Xia side who respected Ji Ning and supported his claim to the Starseizing Manor.
